“Alright,” the man tore up the divorce papers, “I did it all for my brother's child. I just won't be with her anymore.”
Chloe Reed: “You tear one up, I'll draw up another, until you sign it.”
The coldness in the man's eyes was replaced by astonishment.…
overlord-the-multiverse:
When MC was reliving a picture of a goddess, he died. Only meet the goddess, but instead of torturing him to eternity, she gives him wishes. And make him reincarnated in the Overlord world.
As the name suggested, this is multiverse Fan fiction, that means MC will travel through different world like Marvel, DC, High School DXD, My vampire Diaries (may be) , Demon Slayer, etc.
first world: Overlord (Chapter: 1—60)
second World: Highschool DXD (Chapter: 60—215)
Third World: Demon Slayer(Chapter: 216—)
Fourth World: New World (Overlord)
There will be a harem, no NTR or stuff.
Some of you might dislike the Yggdrisil arc as it is a bit of AU and MC talk a lot. But it is only in this arc on world travel that I will tone down his unnecessary internal monologue.
I am not a professional writer, and I have no deep experience in writing, so please ignore my grammar mistakes and such. I also took some inspiration from other fan fiction.
It would be a great help if you could donate your power stone to me.
pick-me-up:
Han Seo-jin is a top ranker of Pick Me Up with an account name of Loki.
Due to a bug he encountered while clearing one of the top floors inside the game, he was summoned inside the game as a hero… a Level 1… 1-Star Hero…
Loki, the once called, master of masters, is now a [Level 1] [1-Star Hero] that must follow the orders of his master.
However…
playing-waterbending-avatar-last-aibende: Finding himself in an Last Airbender without an airbender around, a transmigrator waterbender goes on an adventure to stop the worst from happening to him.
reborn-as-a-beastman-with-a-system:
In a bizarre twist of fate, Damien, an ordinary man from our world, finds himself inexplicably transported to a medieval fantasy realm. But this is not a simple tale of displacement; Damien undergoes a profound transformation, awakening as Logan, a wolf beastman and the destined heir to the chieftainship of the wolf beastmen Tribe.
As Logan, he inherits not just a new form but a complex legacy of power and ambition, underpinned by the dreams of his tribe to elevate their leader to the divine status of a wolf deity. His transformation is accompanied by the mystical Tribal Chief System, a potent force that endows him with extraordinary knowledge and abilities, elevating his potential far beyond any ordinary beastman.
The story intensifies when Logan’s father, the revered chief of the beastmen Silvermane, perishes in battle. This tragedy thrusts Logan into a leadership role much sooner than anticipated. As the new chief, he must navigate a world rife with dangers—both from rival tribes jealous of the Silvermane's prosperity and darker forces that threaten the mystical balance of the realm.
Logan's ascent to power is an arduous journey of personal growth and leadership.…
reborn-with-a-space-hoarding-food-and-ra:
Flora Bloom, who was betrayed and killed by her boyfriend in her past life, is reborn with a peerless spatial dimension back to the time before the crisis, hoarding food, raising a child, and tearing apart scumbag men and manipulative women.
Originally, she just wanted to raise a child and low-key fight zombies and level up together with her family.
But she discovered that she was unexpectedly falling step by step into a tender trap meticulously designed by a certain sly and scheming man.
Flora Bloom looked at the vast space within her sea of consciousness; it had a farmhouse courtyard, fields, and a Spirit River, but it just lacked a bit of vitality.
So, a fat, sky-flying mantis? Collect!
A rare little white tiger that can discharge electricity? Collect!
A behemoth spirit crocodile with its young? Collect!
As long as it's alive and edible, collect, collect, collect them all!
Endless scumbags and vile women, a shameless and deeply scheming leader, all wanting to use her to attack zombies and obtain more Crystal Cores for their own gain?
Your shameless, worthless life? Hand it over.
reincarnated-swordmaster:
Should an untalented guy like me die?
Then I’m going to die.
I will die as you so desire.
After dying, I will challenge the world again.
Until I kill this tr*sh-like world!
ruined-realms:
A Survivor and a Regressor in a Cosmos with their own Eldritch calamities across dimensions and time with their own struggles in their dying worlds.
On Earth 2080, N032, a soldier is the last of mankind following the devastation of World War 3. His reality descends further into an apocalyptic hell when he is swarmed by Eldritch Abyss horrors battling them for thousands of years alone.
Across dimensional tragedies, Anna, the Celestial Regressor endures her own endless torment in the Celestial Realm. She is trapped in a cycle of 41 regressions of apocalyptic eldritch Hell.
Separated by time, dimensions, and Eldritch horrors , countless Survivors must survive. And one day their paths will merge into a journey filled with Tragedy as they face the very hell of their cursed fate trying to break free from it.…
sovereign-of-the-three-realms: Jiang Chen, son of the Heavenly Emperor, unexpectedly reincarnated into the body of a despised young noble, thus embarking on the path of the underdog trouncing all commoners. No one has the right to call himself a genius in front of Jiang Chen, as no one has a better understanding of the heavens than the son of the Heavenly Emperor. “Genius? He who adheres to me shall ascend. Those who oppose me can find solace in hell!’
starting-with-sss-rank-necromancy-talent:
[System Activated]
[EXP: Infinity]
After a shameless death, instead getting going into hell or heaven, he gets dropped in a purgatory world.
He gets transmigrated into this world with what?— An SSS rank Necromancy Talent. But he has one draw back, a weak body.
He has to train his body to be able to contain such power. Even then the price in purgatory as its called isn't a small one—The countless missions all in the name to be favoured by the god to get to heaven.
Admist the chaos, he is wanted by a notorious band. It's mandatory that he regains his full power before they get to him.
stolen-by-the-rebel-king:
As a princess that could not wield magic, Princess Daphne’s only value to her kingdom was her arranged marriage. The task was simple, but when Daphne gets kidnapped and brought to the cold mountains of Vramid, she realizes that she’s in over her head.
She had heard of these cursed mountains before― rocky terrain, freezing temperatures, and the land was ruled by a man feared by many within the continent.
King Atticus Heinvres, the blood-thirsty ruler of the North.
Even though she had never met him before, tales were spread of King Atticus’s ruthlessness. Some said he was a monster, others claimed he was the devil himself, but whatever the story was, everyone knew of the man who had powers beyond anyone’s imagination. He could topple armies and crumble nations with just one wave of his hand, aided by what others rumored to be a cursed obsidian ring.
No one outside of Vramid had ever met the fearsome king before. Not until Daphne.
However, upon meeting the formidable man, Daphne found out that the king might not really be the monster others had claimed him to be.
In fact, what was hidden under that obsidian shield could just be a diamond in the rough.…
suzuki-is-cute-even-in-a-savage-world:
The kind-hearted boy Suzuki was supposed to use his cheat ability to be “unconditionally loved by the local race” and enjoy a peaceful slow life in another world… or so he thought.
However, due to a small mistake by a goddess, he was actually reincarnated into a bloody, end-of-the-century world where humans were being destroyed by demons, with slaughter and torture everywhere.
Suzuki was in a desperate situation!! …But for some reason, the demons who saw him seemed to be acting a little strange – what could this mean?
temporal-pearls:
Using the brain as an Axis to process large amounts of data, an Advance Computer was made that is faster, accurate and more efficient than Quantum Computers.
The only downside was it consumed an infinite amount of energy within a short period of time and also make the human brain stop functioning after prolonged use.
Nevertheless, when a looming threat of destruction encroached on Earth for the second time due to excessive Energy emitted by Beta Asteroid Core, humanity decided to use the Advance Computer to siphon away the excess Energy!
And the fastest way to do that was to make a VR MMORPG Cabin that will allow billions of people to dive in and make use of the Energy.
****
Seth was born with a very low body constitution that made him almost a cripple due to his body getting stressed very fast from any extended physical activity.
He escaped reality by gaming and when he met with an accident he stopped gaming. But when the ultimate game was out, Asteroid Online, Seth was asked to dive again.
Sadly, he found an exact replica of his real-life body in the game. At first, he detested it, but on that first day, Seth was intrigued by the game and wished to explore more.…
the-academys-dud-getting-stronger-with-m:
In a world where everyone gained an RPG-like system to survive the sudden apocalypse, every human became capable of leveling entire streets in under an hour.
So it came as a shock to many when the child of the strongest S-Rank Resonator awakened a dud at the country's most prestigious Resonator Academy. The only system in the world that seemed to reject its user.
In a world filled with Necromancers, Paladins, and Half-Dragons, he somehow ended up with a stupid system that didn’t even recognize him as a Resonator.
But all of that changed after one idiotic, selfless act that his system deemed important enough.
***
[Host Partially Accepted]
[Current Body Too Weak To Gain Abilities]
[Task: Workout]
[Reward: Class - Sovereign]
the-character-that-was-never-written:
Zeres worked himself to the bone his entire life, all for the sake of earning a peaceful, stable future. But just as his hard work finally paid off and his dream was within reach, fate had other plans—he died in an accident and transmigrated into the world of his younger sister’s webnovel.
To make matters even worse, he didn’t end up in the body of a powerful hero, a major villain, or even a notable side character. Instead, he took over the body of someone who was never mentioned or written about in the story at all: a complete unknown.
Now trapped in a world full of magic, mysteries, and dangerous events he only knows from memory, with no special status and useless stats to boot—how will he survive?

the-first-god-tier-necromancer:
In his previous life, Karl awakened the SSS-rank talent Sword God and was expected to become one of the future leaders of the Human Alliance.
But before he could reach his full potential, he was betrayed inside a dungeon by his own team and fiancée. They killed him to claim the final reward, ending his life before he could truly rise.
When Karl opened his eyes again, he found himself back on the day of his class transition.
With his memories, combat experience, and knowledge of the future, he planned to awaken Sword God once more and surpass everything he had achieved in his first life.
Instead, he awakened as a Necromancer.
Necromancers were considered a mediocre profession, known for weak summons, limited fighting methods, and the enormous resources required to grow. Compared to Beast Tamers and Summoners, few believed they had any real future.
But Karl’s awakening also activated a mysterious system and granted him a God-Tier talent, giving him the ability to raise undead far beyond the limits of ordinary necromancers.…
the-game-at-carousel-a-horror-movie-litr:
Could you survive a horror movie?
That's the question Riley must answer after he and his friends get lured to Carousel, a malevolent town where horror movies come to life.
Riley thinks he is in big trouble when he is assigned the Film Buff archetype, a minor support class that has a penchant for dying early in movies. At first resigned to his fate to die over and over, he believes he has found a way to survive. Upon obtaining the Oblivious Bystander trope, monsters and killers will not harm him as long as he can convincingly pretend he has not noticed them. At first, this ability appears to be a joke, but Riley thinks that with some clever exploitation, it might just be his greatest strength.
What to expect:
-Strategic gameplay and clever uses of movie tropes to survive
-Perilous storylines right from your favorite horror movies
-Creative Twists of Classic Horror Movie tropes
-Moderate stats-based combat and strategy
the-sovereign-beast-system-black-of-scal:
Ten years ago, Kren watched his father die.
Beheaded in front of the entire court, on the word of an emperor he'd served faithfully his whole life — accused of a crime he never committed. Of sleeping with the emperor's eldest daughter and heir. A lie dressed up as treason, wielded like an axe.
His father's death didn't end there. It ended his kingdom.
The emperor didn't stop at one execution. He tore the N'kora crest from an entire bloodline, sealing off every feline's ability to cultivate in a single stroke. Overnight, an entire people were stripped of their strength and sold into servitude across the continent — clans, families, children — while the empire that orchestrated it called it justice.
Now, ten years later, Kren finally reclaims what was taken. The crest is his again.
But the old emperor is dead. And the throne now belongs to the very woman who set his father up to die.
Imperial Princess Elyvara.
All Kren wants is his crest and distance — as much of it as the empire allows. Gather what's left of his people. Rebuild in the shadows. Find some way, any way, to claw back a decade of everything they've lost.…
the-uchiha-with-a-mission-system:
“Amazing. I reincarnated, only to receive a VIP ticket straight to a mass grave,” Uchiha Yuji muttered.
Unwilling to die such a ridiculous death, he devoted himself to training with relentless determination. It was the only way to save his own life.
You could say it was training to avoid spoilers.
Just as he was in the middle of his training, a voice suddenly echoed inside his mind.
[Ding! The System Has Been Activated.]
this-f-rank-bubble-mage-is-too-op:
Bubbles…
Soft, fragile, and fleeting. They drift without purpose, bursting at the slightest touch.
They aren’t weapons. They aren’t threats. Just harmless playthings, forgotten the moment they vanish.
But what if bubbles weren’t so innocent?
What if, in a world of Hunters—where magic shatters mountains and fists split seas—someone awakened a Skill based entirely on bubbles?
A joke. A death sentence.
Goblins would laugh.
The weak would pity him. The strong wouldn’t even bother to look twice.
But powers can hide secrets. And some truths are buried in plain sight.
When a nameless F-Rank awakens the “Bubble Skill,” no one expects him to survive.
Let alone rise.
However, the indomitable spirit of River Faelan refused to die.
Step by step, he climbed to the top—shattering every limit placed on a “mere” Bubble Mage.
He proved them all wrong.
And he’ll do it again,
Even if it means starting from the very bottom… for one more time.
urban-divine-doctor-descends-the-mountai:
Lin Dong, who has mastered both the divine medical arts and martial arts, has traveled from the mountains to the city.
With divine medical arts in his left hand and unbeatable martial arts in his right, he roams freely in the city.
villains-harem-in-otome-game:
Eric wants a few simple things in his life— escape his abusive home, get into college, get new friends, get a girlfriend, and lose his virginity to her.
But everything collapsed when he got into a fateful meeting with truck-kun on his first day of college. And an incredible milf goddess offered him a second chance to enter the world of his favourite game, which he was once obsessed with, for the one character—Villainess Seraphina. She's the reason he moved on in his abusive life.
So he just accepted the milf's shady offer and entered into the game.
But he turned out to be Eren Volsver, a minor villain in the game who stalked and harassed the protagonist. A stepping stone for the second lead. An absolute prick who was hated by everyone.
So he just decided to stay on the sidelines and admire his Villainess from afar. But as usual, nothing goes normally in his life.…
